description: Which operators, brands and MVNOs run on which network codes (rule round 32, GOAL decision 2), built from the sources' own labels: LineageOS APN carrier names, Samsung network names and sales codes, Google carrier ID names and Apple bundle names. selectors are the SIM selectors exactly as a source states them, each with the OCD profile it maps to and the source families that state it. host_only means no source gives the brand a selector, so no phone can tell its SIMs from the host's. The table never changes OCD's matcher.
